scope: Real public REST observations and isolated local-paper orders; no credentials or venue orders; no funding-boundary or operating-duration claim.

margin_tiers_snapshot.boundary_policy: Model convention: minimum exclusive, maximum inclusive (min,max]; raw source records are preserved. A next lower bound exactly one native lot above the previous maximum is mapped to that maximum; larger gaps and overlaps are rejected. Not an exchange acceptance claim.

account.pnl_definition: Spot disposal PnL includes proportional entry costs; swap realizes trading fees when charged. Funding is separate. Equity deducts recorded insurance liabilities.
account.ledger_precision: 50 significant digits; finite-context residuals explicitly journaled to rounding_adjustment
account.liquidation_fee_policy: Trading fee plus configured additional liquidation allowance; estimate is a local model, not a venue fee-tier guarantee.

contribution_reconciliation.policy: Proportional net-position reductions; each sleeve retains its own entry costs. Spot entry fees are in basis; swap fees are realized. Net P&L = realized + unrealized − funding. Fees and insurance debt are disclosures, not a second deduction. This is monetary contribution, not independent strategy return.
contribution_reconciliation.legacy_policy: Pre-upgrade balances remain explicitly unattributed legacy.
